create_PartialDecoding: create a PartialDecoding instance to decode a subset of TensorFlow Datasets features
extract_PartialDecoding_features: extract a subset of features from a FeaturesDict using PartialDecoding.extract_features
normalize_feature_item: normalize a feature spec into a FeatureConnector or nested dict structure
normalize_feature_dict: normalize a feature dict spec matching the expected nested feature structure
extract_features: extract matching features from a FeaturesDict by intersecting with expected feature specs
